status: historical hub trial inputs and controls; selected design is logistics_hub_design.json
minimum_efficient_scale: intentional; small businesses should not need to own a hub
scope: Hub-covered directed edge loads, consolidated at each meeting tile and availability turn, independent of shipment origin and initial departure time; existing route eligibility and travel times retained.
rounding: Selected design accumulates usage/service credit across turns; legacy_rounding_control preserves old trial semantics.
price_weights: separate from middleman tariff; do not reuse LC weights for money charges

payload_working_assumption.status: provisional numerical calibration, not an approved gameplay constant
payload_working_assumption.other_cargo: Liquid, hazardous and gas compatibility requires explicit equipment rules; LC weights alone do not imply compatibility.

progression_targets.status: user-selected design targets; overlapping ranges depend on integration and colocation, not hard building-count gates

generic_carrier.intent: best through intermediate scale, depending on integration/completeness/colocation

owned_hub.intent: begin to pay off with substantial traffic between covered production tiles

differentiated_input_trial.status: candidate tested; accumulated-use rule not yet adopted as gameplay default

modal_efficiency_trial.apply_to: actual hub-operated movement mode, not external carrier mode
modal_efficiency_trial.rounding_constraint: Per-turn minimum-one masks efficiency at current benchmark scale. Average savings require accumulated consumption or another explicit revision.

optimisation_target.objective: L2 handoff should earn more total hub operating profit than L1, each choosing its best reachable handoff

level_specific_efficiency_trial.requires: accumulated input usage instead of per-turn minimum-one

legacy_rounding_control: per hub per turn, half-up, minimum one per positive input; idle zero
